prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production website UI background, a blank open Kalistar collector album, NOT a mockup screen. Reference image is STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Create a perfectly front-facing orthographic open album, landscape 2:1 ratio, both pages completely BLANK, symmetrical left and right leaves with a narrow central book gutter. Very thin dark forest-green leather cover, subtle aged copper corner protectors, realistic ivory-gray page edges, soft pale silver/gray fibrous paper (not brown parchment), fine unobtrusive blind embossed geometric filigree only in the outermost margins. Keep 88 percent of each page interior flat, quiet and uninterrupted to receive real HTML cards. Cover fills the canvas tightly edge to edge; corners may have small genuine alpha outside silhouette. Beautiful tangible painted fantasy game UI, mature Kalistar craftsmanship, detailed but restrained. Soft frontal studio light, shallow central fold shadow, no cast shadow covering usable page area. No pockets, no cards, NO characters, no text, no letters, no logo, no numbers, no controls, no buttons, no jewels, no scene background, no perspective tilt. Need one continuous empty open-book substrate suitable for responsive HTML/CSS overlay, not a picture of a finished UI. Keep a near-rectangular exterior outline so it can stretch gracefully.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable UI button frame with REAL TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND and an EMPTY transparent center, for a premium Kalistar fantasy card game HUD. The reference image is style/material inspiration only. Create ONE wide horizontal ornamented rectangular button frame, 4:1 aspect ratio silhouette centered with generous transparent margins. Very thin finely engraved aged copper and pale brass beveled metal rim, clipped angular corners, dark emerald enamel inner lip, a tiny restrained rainbow glass glint centered at the bottom edge. Beautiful handcrafted and credible material, mature elegant game UI. The entire center MUST be plain alpha transparency, to receive native HTML text and icon. Outer background also true alpha. No panel fill in center, no text, no letters, no symbol, no logo, no numbers, no swords, no character, no cards, no scene, no multiple components, no sparkles floating outside silhouette, no glow spilling far. The frame must have continuous straight top/bottom rails suitable for CSS border-image nine-slice, and consistent slim edge thickness. Front view, orthographic, perfectly horizontal, symmetric. Match Kalistar's copper/forest green identity, not yellow gold baroque.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent plastic sleeve pocket overlay for a fantasy card collector album. Real alpha transparency. Perfect frontal orthographic view, vertical portrait shape approximately 0.58 width-to-height. Empty center must be completely transparent so a real game card can be inserted behind it. A slim clear archival plastic sleeve with very restrained pale silver seams, a softly rounded rectangular bottom seal, tiny folded transparent corners, small realistic narrow glossy highlights on the plastic edges, and a subtle transparent insertion lip at the top. Premium tactile Panini-style collector pocket, not a metal card frame, no ornate thick decoration. The pocket has a VERY faint uniform transparent gray tint, otherwise the entire large center is invisible/transparent, absolutely no opaque gray or white fill. External background true alpha. Material is clean clear slightly worn acrylic, understated age, natural soft light. No paper, book, card, printed illustration, text, logo, characters, symbols, numbers, jewels or UI. Keep the exterior rectangular silhouette precisely straight; small radius corners only. One pocket only, no grid. This asset overlays the independent Kalistar native card and lives over ivory-gray album paper.
